mapper.select: SELECT id,order_number orderNumber,user_id userId,product_detail_id skuId,quantity, total_price totalPrice,status,request_id requestId,expires_at expiresAt FROM `order` WHERE order_number=#{number} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(expires_at <= NOW(),TRUE) FROM `order` WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status='TRADE_PAID_SUCCESS',gmt_modified=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='WAIT_BUYER_PAY' AND expires_at > NOW()
